page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-ultramem-112 is a memory-optimized server instance designed for workloads requiring massive memory capacity relative to compute resources. It features 112 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 2976.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields an allocation of approximately 26.57 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This server type does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The absence of local SSDs and GPUs makes this instance highly specialized for memory-bound, non-graphical workloads that rely on persistent network storage.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the m4n-ultramem-112 offers a high density of memory resources per vCPU, reducing the need to provision excess compute cores simply to acquire sufficient RAM. This resource profile is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning applications, massive data caching layers, and large-scale memory-intensive analytics workloads.
